headline: Victoria Election Campaign Includes Proposal to Ax Stamp Duty on Homes Up to $1M
summary: A campaign proposal for the Victoria state election includes abolishing stamp duty for residential property purchases up to $1 million, addressing Gen Z priorities on housing affordability.
why: Stamp duty is a tax levied by Australian state governments on real estate transactions.
